name: Clamshell
summary: Lying on your side facing the phone, open the top knee like a clam without rolling the pelvis back.
setup: Lie on your side facing the phone at floor level, hips and knees bent to about 90°, feet together, head on your arm. Keeping the feet touching and the pelvis stacked, lift the top knee toward the ceiling, pause, lower.
why: Facing the phone, the top knee rises toward the ceiling as the hip turns, and how far it gets above the bottom knee counts the rep. The pelvis rolling back — the fault that matters — draws the two hip points apart in the picture, and the heels coming off each other shows between the ankles. Filmed from behind or above, none of that is visible: face the phone.
tempo: Open 2 s, hold 1 s, close 2 s.
progression: Loop band above the knees; lift the feet off the floor too.
regression: Smaller opening; hand on the top hip to feel it stay still.
contraindications: Pinching at the front of the hip.

faults.label: Rolling the pelvis back
faults.tip: Keep the top hip bone directly above the bottom one. If it tips backward, the knee is opening with the back, not the hip.

faults.label: Feet coming apart
faults.tip: The feet stay touching so the movement is rotation at the hip and not the whole leg lifting.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Flapping the knee
faults.tip: A fast flap is momentum. Slow it down and the glute has to hold the position.

guide.surface: Firm floor or mat; a pillow under the head.
guide.stop: Pinching at the front or side of the hip.
guide.cannotSee: How hard the band is pulling, and whether the top shoulder is rolling with the pelvis.

points.t: Top hip stacked over the bottom hip, still through the whole rep — the two hip points drawing apart is the pelvis rolling back.
Top knee lifts toward the ceiling; how far it gets above the bottom knee is the rep.
Open only as far as the pelvis stays stacked — past that it is the back turning, not the hip.
Two seconds open, a pause, two seconds closed. No flapping.

brief: Lie on your side with the knees bent and the feet together. Lift the top knee toward the ceiling without rolling the pelvis back, pause, then lower.
calibrationPose: Lie on your side with your knees together and stacked, feet touching.

progress.overTip: The knee only opens as far as the pelvis stays stacked — usually less than it feels.
